raw_segments.text: Half an hour ago, he pursued, I spoke of my impatience to hear the sequel of a tale.
On reflection, I find the matter will be better managed by my assuming the narrator's part
and converting you into a listener.
Before commencing, it is but fair to warn you that the story will sound somewhat hackneyed
in your ears, but stale details often regain a degree of freshness when they pass through
For the rest, whether trite or novel, it is short.
